name: CattleBehaviours6: Dairy Cattle Behaviour Recognition Video Dataset
description: CattleBehaviours6 is a curated video benchmark for automated dairy cattle behaviour recognition, published by the University of Bristol on data.bris. Designed to support computer vision and multimodal vision-language frameworks (such as Cattle-CLIP) in precision livestock farming, the collection comprises 1,905 verified video clips capturing six distinct indoor dairy cow behaviours: feeding, drinking, standing-self-grooming, standing-ruminating, lying-self-grooming, and lying-ruminating.
